A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Sith''' served the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in [[3950 BBY]]. Garbed in [[Sith apparel|dark robes]], the man was summoned to the Emperor's throne room in the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]] to take evidence of [[Darth Nyriss]]'s treachery from the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]].
